research_direction: Joshua Oshiro: genuinely higher-order, pre-metric causal rewriting; derive causal dependencies through operations, not graph-overlap resemblance
status: Primary published abstracts/institutional records inspected; the cited paper theorems have NOT been independently reproduced and are NOT assumed to apply to current Causal Step generator.

entries.title: Theory of traces
entries.objects: partially commuting action words and labeled partial-order / acyclic graph models
entries.operations: swap adjacent independent letters according to a specified independence relation; quotient interleavings into traces
entries.transfer: candidate notion of causal equivalence via commuting rewrite histories
entries.assumptions: independence relation must be stated for the action alphabet and domain; a fixed relation on bare edge identities is not justified when enabling/mutation is state-dependent
entries.source_verification: published journal abstract reviewed, detailed proof not reproduced

entries.title: Fundamental Theory for Typed Attributed Graphs and Graph Transformation based on Adhesive HLR Categories
entries.authors: Hartmut Ehrig, Karsten Ehrig, Ulrike Prange, Gabriele Taentzer
entries.objects: typed attributed graphs and adhesive high-level replacement categories
entries.operations: graph transformation via DPO/HLR rules with local Church-Rosser, parallelism, concurrency, embedding and critical-pair results
entries.transfer: candidate precise conditions under which independent typed rewrites commute
entries.assumptions: categorical adhesive HLR structure, morphism/match/gluing, labels and conditions are load bearing; no demonstrated DPO interpretation of current state-mutation and born-node source rule
entries.source_verification: journal abstract reviewed; no imported theorem

entries.title: Domain and event structure semantics for Petri nets with read and inhibitor arcs
entries.authors: Paolo Baldan, Nadia Busi, Andrea Corradini, G. Michele Pinna
entries.objects: Petri nets with reading and inhibition, event structures with dependency and asymmetric conflict
entries.operations: concurrent semantics using context/read arcs and inhibitor constraints; translates to event/domain structure
entries.transfer: most relevant mechanism for overlaps that are observationally read-only and for asymmetric enablement conflicts
entries.assumptions: token/place semantics, domain/event axioms, and net typing require fidelity proof before using with n-ary hypergraph source
entries.source_verification: published abstract and institutional bibliographic record checked; detailed categorical proof not independently checked

entries.title: McMillan's Complete Prefix for Contextual Nets
entries.authors: Paolo Baldan, Andrea Corradini, Barbara König, Stefan Schwoon
entries.published: Transactions on Petri Nets and Other Models of Concurrency I (2008), LNCS
entries.objects: bounded contextual Petri nets with nonconsuming read arcs, occurrence net prefixes
entries.operations: unfolding with histories, enabling contexts, and causal-conflict relations
entries.transfer: explicit precedent that one event may have multiple admissible histories and that shared reads should not automatically create dependence
entries.assumptions: bounded semi-weighted contextual nets; current Causal Step toy has forced node birth and may grow without bound
entries.source_verification: institutional record/author abstract verified; theorem not reproduced

entries.title: Efficient unfolding of contextual Petri nets
entries.authors: Paolo Baldan, Alessandro Bruni, Andrea Corradini, Barbara König, César Rodríguez, Stefan Schwoon
entries.objects: contextual nets extended with read arcs
entries.operations: context-preserving unfoldings representing truly concurrent read-only access without forcing artificial read/write cycles
entries.transfer: potentially more faithful than pairwise touch order for comparing nonconsuming source participation
entries.assumptions: bounded-state unfolding formalisms have resource/marking constraints not yet derived from primitive hypergraph rewriting
entries.source_verification: published journal abstract verified; no theorem assumed
